decisions.reason: The accepted one-off exception necessarily modifies ticket issuance: the contract's initial mint cannot award a random no-referral ticket because no earlier NFT exists to receive it.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yeah, that’s fine, since it’s a one-off and won’t have any impact going forward.

value_updates.first_mint_ticket_issuance_exception: The contract's initial mint does not issue a ticket because no earlier NFT exists to receive the random no-referral ticket.
